The text is a double sestina in the 6 end-words

1 mountains = M, 2 valleys = V, 3 forests = F, 4 music = Mu, 5 morning = Mo, 6 evening = E

Stanza 1–6 and stanza 7–12 are the normal sestina rotation

1-6  M V F Mu Mo E
7-12 E M Mo V Mu F
13-18 F E Mu M V Mo
19-24 Mo F V E M Mu
25-30 Mu Mo M F E V
31-36 V Mu E Mo F M

etc. and the 12 sextets repeat the same rotation, i.e. a sestina doppia.

occur once in the three closing lines, two words to a line.

74 Long since, alas, my deadly swannish music                Mu
75 Our morning hymn is this, and song at evening.          Mo E

74 Long since, alas, my deadly swannish music  Mu

leaves the end-word position of every sextet intact – both lines end in
Mu – and restores a normal envoi

74 F Mu
75 Mo E
